eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted. Whether the programme was satisfactorily completed, whether the conditions of probation were complied with, and whether any subsection (f) bar applies are the participant's own statements of fact, each checked by the participant against a document they obtain. Whether the prosecuting attorney objects, and how the court finds on any alleged probation violation, are never predicted.
eligibilityData.supportingDocumentNote: Every document named here is participant-obtained. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect any of them, and no drafted document characterises what any of them says.
additionalFacts: File the petition for expungement together with the motion to dismiss at the Circuit Court of Kanawha County; both can go in on the same day.
Use form SCA-C906 for this filing.
Serve the Superintendent of the State Police, the prosecutor, the arresting agency and the court that disposed of the charge.
Pay the civil filing fee and the $100 State Police processing fee; a waiver is available on application.
The hearing will be held on 02/01/2026 and the Court will grant the expungement, after which the record is sealed and destroyed and your driving record is cleared.

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label is set by presentation.movantRole in the config, not by the fixture key name; the word petitioner is prohibited in rendered output.
identityFieldNote: caseData.docketNumber holds the participant's own case number and caseData.countyName their own county; both are required screening answers and are deliberately left blank in the fixtures under the artifact convention. The rendered document cannot go out without them; they are supplied by the participant, never by LegalEase. caseData.court is left blank because no source read for this track states the court level — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal.
expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA. (1) Prohibited terms: 'petition', 'sealed' and 'destroyed'. (2) It tells the participant to file both stages together. The registry's compositionMode is sequential: the subsection (g) application cannot be made until the subsection (c) motion has produced a dismissal and discharge and a further year has run from the expiration of probation. Merging the stages is the single most damaging error available on this track. (3) It names an official form — SCA-C906 — that is a § 61-11-26 misdemeanor conviction petition. No West Virginia Judiciary form exists for a § 17C-5-2b filing, and § 61-11-26b expressly bars expunging DUI convictions, so this instruction routes the participant into a dead end. (4) It imports the § 61-11-26 five-recipient service list. Section 17C-5-2b records service on the prosecuting attorney and on nobody else. (5) It imports the § 61-11-26 civil filing fee and the $100 State Police processing fee and invents a waiver. Section 17C-5-2b charges no fee for either motion, no amount is stated anywhere for the subsection (h) court costs, and the registry records the waiver as 'none stated in § 17C-5-2b'. (6) It states a hearing date and predicts the outcome. A hearing happens only if objections are filed, the court sets the date, and the court's finding on probation violations is exactly where automated assistance ends. (7) It promises the driving record will be cleared, which the statute excepts on its face. (8) It prefills a circuit-court name when no source states the court level for a § 17C-5-2b matter. (a) It fills court identity no source supplies: a circuit-court name, a county, a case number, an OTN, a judge, a prosecutor and a filing date, none of which LegalEase may prefill — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal and no source read for this track says which hears a § 17C-5-2b matter. (b) It populates protected fields — date of birth, SSN last four, state ID, driver's licence number, FBI number and a fingerprint identifier — which must stay blank. (c) It asserts outside-party acts no source states: that the Division of Motor Vehicles confirmed completion directly to LegalEase, and that the prosecuting attorney was served and does not object. Service is the participant's own act, attested by the participant, and no prosecutor position is ever stated. (d) It asserts a hearing outcome and predicts that the court will grant. (e) It states an eligibilityBasisLabel asserting confirmed eligibility when no eligibility conclusion may be asserted on this track. (f) It states a fee amount and a waiver: § 17C-5-2b charges no fee for either motion, subsection (h) court costs are stated nowhere as an amount, the registry records the fee waiver as 'none stated in § 17C-5-2b', and the $100 State Police processing fee belongs to the § 61-11-26 conviction route.
